text: Limited liability lets managers and shareholders capture most of the benefits of excessive risk taking while not bearing all of its costs, which is one explanation for why bankers take excessive risk.
citation: Painter and Kaal, Initial Reflections on an Evolving Standard Constraints on Risk Taking by Directors and Officers in (2010). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=1558614
